title: When the Oath Wakes Again
premise: Tamsin Eastwick, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps ledgers for a guild that trades in impossible things — until he discovers tonight's date inscribed in a century-old book of prophecies, naming him as the one who will either reforge or destroy the covenant binding the mortal realm to the fae Otherworld. Hunted by the guild's masters, who profit from the covenant's decay, and guided by a prophecy-ghost who may be his own future self, Tamsin must gather the scattered shards of the broken Oath and learn what it truly cost the first swordspeakers. In the end, he refuses to restore the old covenant and instead swears a new one in his own name, sacrificing his swordspeech to bind the realms by consent rather than compulsion — and choosing, at last, who he is rather than what he was made to be.
about_author: Ivo Whitlock is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval legal oaths before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about contracts, conscience, and the people trapped between them.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. He catalogs a bottled storm and a stolen shadow for the Guild of Rare Exchanges, establishing his meticulous, detached life as keeper of the ledgers. Emotional beat: quiet loneliness beneath professional pride.

chapters.title: A Date Written a Century Ago
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Auditing an old acquisition, he finds a prophetic ledger listing tonight's date — with his own name beside it. Emotional beat: vertigo, the ground of routine giving way.

chapters.title: The Pull
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. At midnight the prophecy activates; the shop folds around him and he is drawn through a door that shouldn't exist into the borderland between realms. Emotional beat: terror and reluctant exhilaration.

chapters.title: Where the Road Remembers
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Lost in the borderland, he meets Vespera, a ghost bound to the prophecy-book, who claims she wrote it — a hundred years from now. Emotional beat: disbelief hardening into wary alliance.

chapters.title: The Broken Covenant
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV (as narrator-ghost). She explains the Oath: a covenant sworn by twelve swordspeakers binding both realms, now shattered, its failure bleeding magic and monsters across borders. Emotional beat: grief for a catastrophe she witnessed.

chapters.title: First Blood on Old Ground
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. A hollowed knight attacks them; under threat, Tamsin's dormant swordspeech wakes, and words become blades. Emotional beat: fear of his own power.

chapters.title: The Guild Knew
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Returning briefly through a rift, he finds his master Corvane waiting, revealing the Guild has guarded the prophecy for generations — and wants the covenant kept broken. Emotional beat: betrayal.

chapters.title: Twelve Names, Eleven Graves
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. She names the original swordspeakers; eleven are dead, their oath-shards scattered. The twelfth name is smudged — deliberately. Emotional beat: dread of what was erased.

chapters.title: The Market at the World's Edge
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. To find the first shard he bargains at a fae market, trading a memory of his mother's face. Emotional beat: the first real price of the quest.

chapters.title: Shard One: The Word That Cuts
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. He claims the shard from a drowned chapel, but speaking its word nearly unmakes him. Emotional beat: awe curdling into addiction's warning.

chapters.title: Corvane's Offer
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. The Guildmaster offers Tamsin wealth, safety, and erasure of the prophecy if he walks away, revealing the Guild feeds on the borderlands' chaos. Emotional beat: seductive corruption.

chapters.title: Refusal and Reckoning
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Tamsin refuses and flees, wounded, saved by a fae outcast named Briar who owes the old covenant a debt. Emotional beat: resolve purchased with pain.

chapters.title: What the Fae Lost Too
chapters.summary: Briar's POV. Briar shows him the Otherworld's blighted edge — the fae suffer the broken covenant equally. Emotional beat: empathy dissolving prejudice.

chapters.title: Shard Two: The Word That Binds
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Hidden in a living tree-court, the shard tests him with illusions of the life he abandoned. Emotional beat: temptation of retreat, overcome.

chapters.title: The Smudged Name
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. Vespera confesses the twelfth swordspeaker was erased because they tried to break the covenant on purpose — and Vespera helped kill them. Emotional beat: guilt unveiled.

chapters.title: Hollow Knights Rising
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Corvane unleashes hollowed knights — dead swordspeakers puppeted by the Guild. A running battle across the borderlands. Emotional beat: relentless pursuit, exhaustion.

chapters.title: Shard Three: The Word That Opens
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Inside a hollow knight's chest he finds a shard fused to its heart; freeing it means letting the knight die twice. Emotional beat: mercy as violence.

chapters.title: The City That Sits on the Seam
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. They reach Greyharrow, a city straddling both realms, where mortals and fae coexist uneasily — proof coexistence is possible. Emotional beat: fragile hope.

chapters.title: Justice Outside the Law
chapters.summary: Briar's POV. Greyharrow's magistrates serve the Guild; Briar shows Tamsin the underground courts where the wronged seek redress the law denies. Emotional beat: anger at institutional rot, admiration for defiance.

chapters.title: Shard Four: The Word That Lies
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. The shard is held by a prophet-pretender whose false visions have ruled a district; defeating her means out-lying a liar. Emotional beat: moral compromise, self-disgust.

chapters.title: Vespera's Century
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. Flashback: how Vespera and the twelfth swordspeaker — revealed as her sister Ysolde — fell out over breaking versus mending the Oath. Emotional beat: tragic love and schism.

chapters.title: Ysolde's Shard
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. The fifth shard lies in Ysolde's unmarked grave, guarded by her final curse against betrayers. Vespera must face it. Emotional beat: confrontation with the past.

chapters.title: Forgiveness Is Not Forgetting
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. Vespera endures the curse, confessing aloud, and the shard releases — not to her hands but to Tamsin's, naming him heir. Emotional beat: catharsis, uneasy inheritance.

chapters.title: Half the Words
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. With five shards, Tamsin can mend the covenant partially — enough to seal the border forever, trapping the fae. Corvane publicly offers this 'safe' solution. Emotional beat: the easy wrong dressed as peace.

chapters.title: Greyharrow Chooses
chapters.summary: Multiple brief POVs. Citizens, fae, and exiles debate at the underground court whether half a covenant is better than none. Emotional beat: democracy of the desperate.

chapters.title: The Guild Moves
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. Corvane seizes Greyharrow's seam-gates, arrests Briar, and declares Tamsin an oath-breaker, turning public fear into a manhunt. Emotional beat: cold machinery of power.

chapters.title: Prison of Salt and Iron
chapters.summary: Briar's POV. Briar endures interrogation designed to strip fae identity, refusing to give up Tamsin's location. Emotional beat: endurance, dignity under torture.

chapters.title: Rescue at the Seam-Gate
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Tamsin raids the gate-prison with Greyharrow's underground; the fight goes wrong and Vespera burns most of her remaining substance to shield them. Emotional beat: sacrifice, fury.

chapters.title: What Swordspeech Costs
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Overusing the shards, Tamsin begins losing his own memories — the power is written in the speaker's self. Emotional beat: horror at dissolution of identity.

chapters.title: The Twelfth Name Was Mine
chapters.summary: Vespera's POV. The revelation: the smudged name is Eastwick — Tamsin is Ysolde's descendant, born to finish or undo her work. Emotional beat: destiny as inheritance, not choice.

chapters.title: Corvane Ascendant
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. Corvane claims the Guild's hoarded shard-pieces and begins a counterfeit mending that would crown him arbiter of both realms. Emotional beat: ambition fully unmasked.

chapters.title: Gathering the Unlikely
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Fae exiles, Greyharrow's underground justices, and two freed hollow knights rally to Tamsin — an army of the lawless and the dispossessed. Emotional beat: belonging found among outsiders.

chapters.title: March on the Seams
chapters.summary: Briar's POV. The ragged host assaults the Guild's fortress at the great seam; Briar fights free of her chains mid-battle. Emotional beat: rising courage, camaraderie.

chapters.title: The Counterfeit Covenant
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Inside, Tamsin witnesses Corvane's false mending warping reality — borders screaming, blended creatures dying. Emotional beat: urgency, righteous anger.

chapters.title: Duel of Ledgers
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Tamsin confronts Corvane, who offers partnership one last time; their duel is fought with spoken words as much as steel. Emotional beat: pity for a man who chose power over self.

chapters.title: The Word That Ends
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. To stop the counterfeit, Tamsin speaks the forbidden final shard-word, shattering Corvane's working — and losing his mother's memory entirely, then his own name. Emotional beat: devastation, near-erasure.

chapters.title: Who Speaks the New Oath
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. At the seam's heart, with all shards assembled, no one can safely speak the new covenant — except someone willing to give up swordspeech forever. Emotional beat: hushed gravity.

chapters.title: When the Oath Wakes Again
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Tamsin swears the new covenant in his own chosen words — consent, not compulsion — surrendering his power and nearly himself; Vespera spends her last substance anchoring his identity. Emotional beat: transcendence through sacrifice.

chapters.title: After the Binding
chapters.summary: Briar's POV. The realms settle into open, negotiated contact; Greyharrow becomes the treaty-city; the Guild collapses as its monopoly breaks. Emotional beat: weary, earned hope.

chapters.title: The Empty Ledger
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. Powerless but whole, Tasmim opens a new ledger — blank pages for a world writing its own terms — while Vespera's book closes at last. Emotional beat: peace, authorship of one's own story.
